import json, tempfile
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
from factoryline.product_missions import compile_product_prd, create_mission, plan_value_slices
from factoryline.proof_delta import create_proof_delta, verify_proof_delta
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
    root = Path(raw)
    prd = root / "PRD.md"
    prd.write_text("# Approval\n## Actors\n- Owner: owns approval.\n## Requirements\n- REQ-APPROVE: The system must reject a non-manager approval.\n## Acceptance\nScenario: Reject a non-manager\n  Given a non-manager actor\n  When the actor approves\n  Then the system rejects the action\n", encoding="utf-8")
    graph = compile_product_prd(prd, root)
    slices = plan_value_slices(Path(graph["path"]), root)
    mission = create_mission(Path(slices["path"]), slices["slices"][0]["id"], root, "smoke-owner")
    def candidate(name, digest, evidence_name):
        evidence = root / evidence_name
        evidence.write_text(name, encoding="utf-8")
        path = root / f"{name}.json"
        path.write_text(json.dumps({"schema": "factory.mission.candidate.v1", "mission_id": mission["id"], "candidate": {"diff_sha256": digest, "changed_paths": ["src/approval.py"]}, "evidence": [{"path": evidence_name, "sha256": sha256(evidence.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "kind": "counterexample"}]}), encoding="utf-8")
        return path
    before = candidate("before", "a" * 64, "before.txt")
    after = candidate("after", "b" * 64, "after.txt")
    failure = root / "failure.json"
    failure.write_text(json.dumps({"schema": "factory.mission.validation-failure.v1", "mission_id": mission["id"]}), encoding="utf-8")
    out = root / ".factory" / "proof-deltas" / "smoke.json"
    result = create_proof_delta(root, Path(mission["path"]), before, after, failure, mission["completion_contract"]["criteria"][0]["id"], out)
    assert result["marker"] == "PROOF_DELTA_ADVANCE"
    assert verify_proof_delta(root, out)["eligible"] is True
print("PROOF_DELTA_ADVANCE")
